;(function () {
  var _caughtErrors = []

  var errorChannel = (function () {
    var subscribers = []

    function publish(msg) {
      for (var i = 0; i < subscribers.length; i += 1) {
        subscribers[i](msg)
      }
    }

    function subscribe(subscriber) {
      subscribers.push(subscriber)

      return function () {
        var idx = subscribers.indexOf(subscriber)

        if (idx > -1) {
          subscribers.splice(idx, 1)
        }
      }
    }

    return {publish, subscribe, subscribers}
  })()

  // NOTE: Store the error channel instance in the global scope so that the application can
  // access it and subscribe to errors.
  window.__sanityErrorChannel = {
    subscribe: errorChannel.subscribe,
  }

  function _nextTick(callback) {
    setTimeout(callback, 0)
  }

  function _handleError(error, params) {
    _nextTick(function () {
      // - If there are error channel subscribers, then we notify them (no console error).
      // - If there are no subscribers, then we log the error to the console and render the error overlay.
      if (errorChannel.subscribers.length) {
        errorChannel.publish({error, params})
      } else {
        console.error(error)

        _renderErrorOverlay(error, params)
      }
    })
  }

  var ERROR_BOX_STYLE = [
    'background: #fff',
    'border-radius: 6px',
    'box-sizing: border-box',
    'color: #121923',
    'flex: 1',
    "font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue','Liberation Sans',Helvetica,Arial,system-ui,sans-serif",
    'font-size: 16px',
    'line-height: 21px',
    'margin: 0 auto',
    'max-width: 960px',
    'max-height: 90dvh',
    'overflow: auto',
    'padding: 20px',
    'width: 100%',
  ].join(';')

  var ERROR_CODE_STYLE = [
    'color: #972E2A',
    "font-family: -apple-system-ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace",
    'font-size: 13px',
    'line-height: 17px',
    'margin: 0',
  ].join(';')

  function _renderErrorOverlay(error, params) {
    var errorElement = document.querySelector('#__sanityError') || document.createElement('div')
    var colno = params.event.colno
    var lineno = params.event.lineno
    var filename = params.event.filename

    errorElement.id = '__sanityError'
    errorElement.innerHTML = [
      '<div style="' + ERROR_BOX_STYLE + '">',
      '<div style="font-weight: 700;">Uncaught error: ' + error.message + '</div>',
      '<div style="color: #515E72; font-size: 13px; line-height: 17px; margin: 10px 0;">' +
        filename +
        ':' +
        lineno +
        ':' +
        colno +
        '</div>',
      '<pre style="' + ERROR_CODE_STYLE + '">' + error.stack + '</pre>',
      '</div>',
    ].join('')

    errorElement.style.position = 'fixed'
    errorElement.style.zIndex = 1000000
    errorElement.style.top = 0
    errorElement.style.left = 0
    errorElement.style.right = 0
    errorElement.style.bottom = 0
    errorElement.style.padding = '20px'
    errorElement.style.background = 'rgba(16,17,18,0.66)'
    errorElement.style.display = 'flex'
    errorElement.style.alignItems = 'center'
    errorElement.style.justifyContent = 'center'

    document.body.appendChild(errorElement)
  }

  // NOTE:
  // Yes – we're attaching 2 error listeners below 👀
  // This is because React makes the same error throw twice (in development mode).
  // See: https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/10384

  // Error listener #1
  window.onerror = function (event, source, lineno, colno, error) {
    _nextTick(function () {
      if (_caughtErrors.indexOf(error) !== -1) return

      _caughtErrors.push(error)

      _handleError(error, {
        event,
        lineno,
        colno,
        source,
      })

      _nextTick(function () {
        var idx = _caughtErrors.indexOf(error)

        if (idx > -1) _caughtErrors.splice(idx, 1)
      })
    })

    // IMPORTANT: this callback must return `true` to prevent the error from being rendered in
    // the browser’s console.
    return true
  }

  // Error listener #2
  window.addEventListener('error', function (event) {
    if (_caughtErrors.indexOf(event.error) !== -1) return true

    _caughtErrors.push(event.error)

    _handleError(event.error, {
      event,
      lineno: event.lineno,
      colno: event.colno,
    })

    _nextTick(function () {
      _nextTick(function () {
        var idx = _caughtErrors.indexOf(event.error)

        if (idx > -1) _caughtErrors.splice(idx, 1)
      })
    })

    return true
  })
})()

# Sanity Clean Content Studio

Congratulations, you have now installed the Sanity Content Studio, an open-source real-time content editing environment connected to the Sanity backend.

Now you can do the following things:

- [Read “getting started” in the docs](https://www.sanity.io/docs/introduction/getting-started?utm_source=readme)
- [Join the Sanity community](https://www.sanity.io/community/join?utm_source=readme)
- [Extend and build plugins](https://www.sanity.io/docs/content-studio/extending?utm_source=readme)

===== FILE: studio/sanity.config.js =====
import {defineConfig} from 'sanity'
import {structureTool} from 'sanity/structure' // Pastikan import structureTool dari sini
import {visionTool} from '@sanity/vision'
import {schemaTypes} from './schemaTypes'

// Tentukan mana saja dokumen yang bersifat Singleton (hanya 1 dokumen)
const singletonActions = new Set(["publish", "discardChanges", "restore"])
const singletonTypes = new Set(["siteSettings", "navbarSettings", "footerSettings", "homePage", "pageTeam", "popupAnnouncement"])

export default defineConfig({
  name: 'default',
  title: 'SMA ABBS Yogyakarta Studio',
  projectId: process.env.SANITY_STUDIO_PROJECT_ID || '8gsqkkhv',
  dataset: 'production',

  plugins: [
    structureTool({
      structure: (S) =>
        S.list()
          .title('Menu Utama')
          .items([
            // KELOMPOK PENGATURAN GLOBAL
            S.listItem()
              .title('⚙️ Pengaturan Global')
              .child(
                S.list()
                  .title('Pengaturan Global')
                  .items([
                    S.listItem().title('Umum & Sosmed').id('siteSettings').child(S.document().schemaType('siteSettings').documentId('siteSettings')),
                    S.listItem().title('Navbar Menu').id('navbarSettings').child(S.document().schemaType('navbarSettings').documentId('navbarSettings')),
                    S.listItem().title('Footer Area').id('footerSettings').child(S.document().schemaType('footerSettings').documentId('footerSettings')),
                    S.listItem().title('📢 Popup Pengumuman').id('popupAnnouncement').child(S.document().schemaType('popupAnnouncement').documentId('popupAnnouncement')),
                  ])
              ),
            
            S.divider(),

            // HALAMAN SINGLETON LAINNYa
            S.listItem().title('🏠 Halaman Depan').id('homePage').child(S.document().schemaType('homePage').documentId('homePage')),
            S.listItem().title('👥 Halaman: Guru & Staf').id('pageTeam').child(S.document().schemaType('pageTeam').documentId('pageTeam')),

            S.divider(),

            // SISANYA (Berita, dsb)
            ...S.documentTypeListItems().filter(
              (listItem) => !singletonTypes.has(listItem.getId())
            ),
          ]),
    }),
    visionTool(),
  ],

  schema: {
    types: schemaTypes,
  },

  document: {
    // Sembunyikan tombol "Create New" untuk dokumen Singleton
    newDocumentOptions: (prev, { creationContext }) => {
      if (creationContext.type === 'global') {
        return prev.filter((templateItem) => !singletonTypes.has(templateItem.templateId))
      }
      return prev
    },
    // Hilangkan opsi Delete/Duplicate untuk dokumen Singleton
    actions: (prev, { schemaType }) => {
      if (singletonTypes.has(schemaType)) {
        return prev.filter(({ action }) => singletonActions.has(action))
      }
      return prev
    },
  },
})

import {defineType, defineArrayMember} from 'sanity'

export default defineType({
  title: 'Block Content',
  name: 'blockContent',
  type: 'array',
  of: [
    defineArrayMember({
      title: 'Block',
      type: 'block',
      styles: [
        {title: 'Normal', value: 'normal'},
        {title: 'Heading 2', value: 'h2'},
        {title: 'Heading 3', value: 'h3'},
        {title: 'Heading 4', value: 'h4'},
        {title: 'Kutipan', value: 'blockquote'},
        {title: 'Lead (Teks Besar)', value: 'lead'},
      ],
      lists: [
        {title: 'Bullet', value: 'bullet'},
        {title: 'Number', value: 'number'}
      ],
      marks: {
        decorators: [
          {title: 'Bold', value: 'strong'},
          {title: 'Italic', value: 'em'},
          {title: 'Underline', value: 'underline'},
          {title: 'Coret', value: 'strike-through'},
        ],
        annotations: [
          {
            title: 'URL Link',
            name: 'link',
            type: 'object',
            fields: [
              {
                title: 'URL',
                name: 'href',
                type: 'url',
                validation: Rule => Rule.uri({
                  scheme: ['http', 'https', 'mailto', 'tel']
                })
              },
              {
                title: 'Buka di Tab Baru?',
                name: 'blank',
                type: 'boolean',
                initialValue: true
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    }),
    defineArrayMember({
      type: 'image',
      options: {hotspot: true},
      fields: [
        {name: 'caption', type: 'string', title: 'Caption'},
        {name: 'alt', type: 'string', title: 'Alternative Text'}
      ]
    }),
  ],
})

===== FILE: studio/schemaTypes/post.js =====
import {defineField, defineType} from 'sanity'

export default defineType({
  name: 'post',
  title: 'Berita & Artikel',
  type: 'document',
  fields: [
    // 1. JUDUL BERITA
    defineField({
      name: 'title',
      title: 'Judul Berita',
      type: 'string',
      validation: (rule) => rule.required(),
    }),

    // 2. SLUG (URL LINK)
    defineField({
      name: 'slug',
      title: 'Link URL (Slug)',
      type: 'slug',
      options: {
        source: 'title',
        maxLength: 96,
      },
      validation: (rule) => rule.required(),
    }),

    // 3. TANGGAL PUBLISH
    defineField({
      name: 'publishedAt',
      title: 'Tanggal Publish',
      type: 'datetime',
      initialValue: () => new Date().toISOString(),
    }),

    // 4. KATEGORI (DROPDOWN)
    defineField({
      name: 'category',
      title: 'Kategori / Label',
      type: 'string',
      options: {
        list: [
          {title: 'Prestasi', value: 'Prestasi'},
          {title: 'Kegiatan Sekolah', value: 'Kegiatan Sekolah'},
          {title: 'Akademik', value: 'Akademik'},
          {title: 'Tahfidz', value: 'Tahfidz'},
          {title: 'Artikel', value: 'Artikel'},
          {title: 'Info PPS', value: 'Info PPS'},
        ],
      },
      validation: (rule) => rule.required(),
    }),

    defineField({
      name: 'tags',
      title: 'Tags / Kata Kunci',
      type: 'array',
      of: [{type: 'string'}],
      options: {
        layout: 'tags' // Tampilan input jadi seperti chip/tag
      }
    }),

    // 5. GAMBAR UTAMA (HERO IMAGE)
    defineField({
      name: 'mainImage',
      title: 'Gambar Utama (Cover)',
      type: 'image',
      options: {
        hotspot: true, // Agar bisa atur titik fokus crop
      },
      fields: [
        {
          name: 'alt',
          type: 'string',
          title: 'Alternative Text',
        }
      ]
    }),

    // 6. ISI BERITA (RICH TEXT + GAMBAR + TABEL)
    defineField({
      name: 'body',
      title: 'Isi Konten',
      type: 'blockContent',
    }),
  ],

  // KONFIGURASI TAMPILAN LIST DI ADMIN
  preview: {
    select: {
      title: 'title',
      author: 'category',
      media: 'mainImage',
    },
    prepare(selection) {
      const {author} = selection
      return {...selection, subtitle: author && `Kategori: ${author}`}
    },
  },
})

===== FILE: web/README.md =====
# Astro Starter Kit: Minimal

```sh
npm create astro@latest -- --template minimal
```

> 🧑‍🚀 **Seasoned astronaut?** Delete this file. Have fun!

## 🚀 Project Structure

Inside of your Astro project, you'll see the following folders and files:

```text
/
├── public/
├── src/
│   └── pages/
│       └── index.astro
└── package.json
```

Astro looks for `.astro` or `.md` files in the `src/pages/` directory. Each page is exposed as a route based on its file name.

There's nothing special about `src/components/`, but that's where we like to put any Astro/React/Vue/Svelte/Preact components.

Any static assets, like images, can be placed in the `public/` directory.

## 🧞 Commands

All commands are run from the root of the project, from a terminal:

| Command                   | Action                                           |
| :------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------- |
| `npm install`             | Installs dependencies                            |
| `npm run dev`             | Starts local dev server at `localhost:4321`      |
| `npm run build`           | Build your production site to `./dist/`          |
| `npm run preview`         | Preview your build locally, before deploying     |
| `npm run astro ...`       | Run CLI commands like `astro add`, `astro check` |
| `npm run astro -- --help` | Get help using the Astro CLI                     |

## 👀 Want to learn more?

Feel free to check [our documentation](https://docs.astro.build) or jump into our [Discord server](https://astro.build/chat).



===== FILE: web/astro.config.mjs =====
// @ts-check
import { defineConfig } from 'astro/config';

import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';

import sanity from '@sanity/astro';

        border-color: rgba(128,0,0,0.5);

<script is:inline>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
        const closeMenuBtn = document.getElementById('closeMenuBtn');
        const fullMenu = document.getElementById('fullMenu');
        const menuPanel = document.getElementById('menuPanel');
        const menuBackdrop = document.getElementById('menuBackdrop');
        const menuDeco = document.getElementById('menuDeco');
        const mainMenuList = document.getElementById('mainMenuList');

        const openMenu = () => {
            fullMenu.classList.remove('pointer-events-none');

            // Backdrop
            menuBackdrop.classList.remove('opacity-0');
            menuBackdrop.classList.add('opacity-95');

            // Panel Slider
            menuPanel.classList.remove('-translate-x-full');
            menuPanel.classList.add('translate-x-0');

            // Deco Panel Kanan
            if (menuDeco) {
                menuDeco.classList.remove('opacity-0');
                menuDeco.classList.add('opacity-100');
            }

            mainMenuList?.classList.add('menu-open');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        };

        const closeMenu = () => {
            fullMenu.classList.add('pointer-events-none');

            menuBackdrop.classList.remove('opacity-95');
            menuBackdrop.classList.add('opacity-0');

            menuPanel.classList.remove('translate-x-0');
            menuPanel.classList.add('-translate-x-full');

            if (menuDeco) {
                menuDeco.classList.remove('opacity-100');
                menuDeco.classList.add('opacity-0');
            }

            mainMenuList?.classList.remove('menu-open');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
        };

        menuBtn?.addEventListener('click', openMenu);
        closeMenuBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
        menuBackdrop?.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);

        // Submenu accordion
        document.querySelectorAll('.submenu-trigger').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const targetId = btn.getAttribute('data-target');
                const panel = document.getElementById(targetId);
                const isOpen = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';

                // Close all others
                document.querySelectorAll('.submenu-trigger').forEach(other => {
                    if (other !== btn) {
                        other.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                        const otherId = other.getAttribute('data-target');
                        const otherPanel = document.getElementById(otherId);
                        if (otherPanel) otherPanel.classList.remove('open');
                    }
                });

                // Toggle current
                btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'false' : 'true');
                if (panel) panel.classList.toggle('open', !isOpen);
            });
        });
    });
</script>

===== FILE: web/src/components/PopupModal.astro =====
---
// src/components/PopupModal.astro
import { sanityClient } from "sanity:client";
import { createImageUrlBuilder } from "@sanity/image-url";

const data: any = await sanityClient.fetch(`{
  "popup": *[_type == "popupAnnouncement" && _id == "popupAnnouncement"][0]
}`);
const { popup } = data;

const builder = createImageUrlBuilder(sanityClient);
function urlFor(source: any) {
  return builder.image(source).auto('format');
}

const now = new Date();
const withinDate =
  (!popup?.startDate || new Date(popup.startDate) <= now) &&
  (!popup?.endDate || new Date(popup.endDate) >= now);
const shouldShow = popup?.isActive && popup?.image && withinDate;

const imgUrl = shouldShow ? urlFor(popup.image).width(800).url() : null;
---

{shouldShow && (
  <div id="popupOverlay" class="fixed inset-0 z-[120] hidden items-center justify-center bg-[#0a0a0a] opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-300 p-4">
    <div id="popupPanel" class="relative max-w-lg w-full scale-95 transition-transform duration-300">
      <button id="popupClose" aria-label="Tutup"
        class="absolute -top-4 -right-4 w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white text-gray-900 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg hover:bg-yellow-400 transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer z-10">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
      </button>
      {popup.link ? (
        <a href={popup.link}>
          <img src={imgUrl} alt="Pengumuman" class="w-full h-auto rounded-sm shadow-2xl" />
        </a>
      ) : (
        <img src={imgUrl} alt="Pengumuman" class="w-full h-auto rounded-sm shadow-2xl" />
      )}
    </div>
  </div>
)}

<script is:inline>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const KEY = 'popup-shown';
    const overlay = document.getElementById('popupOverlay');
    const panel = document.getElementById('popupPanel');
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('popupClose');

    const openPopup = () => {
      if (!overlay) return;
      overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
      overlay.classList.add('flex');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        overlay.classList.remove('opacity-0');
        panel?.classList.remove('scale-95');
      });
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    };

    const closePopup = () => {
      if (!overlay) return;
      overlay.classList.add('opacity-0');
      panel?.classList.add('scale-95');
      setTimeout(() => {
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
        overlay.classList.remove('flex');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
      }, 300);
    };

    if (overlay && !sessionStorage.getItem(KEY)) {
      setTimeout(openPopup, 400);
      sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, '1');
    }

    closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closePopup);
    overlay?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === overlay) closePopup();
    });
  });
</script>

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const videoModal = document.getElementById('globalVideoLightbox');
            const closeVideoBtn = document.getElementById('closeGlobalVideo');
            const videoIframe = document.getElementById('globalVideoIframe');
            
            const videoTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.open-video'); 

            videoTriggers.forEach(trigger => {
                trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    let videoUrl = trigger.getAttribute('data-video');
                    if(videoUrl) {
                        if (videoUrl.includes('watch?v=')) {
                            videoUrl = videoUrl.replace('watch?v=', 'embed/');
                        } else if (videoUrl.includes('youtu.be/')) {
                            videoUrl = videoUrl.replace('youtu.be/', 'youtube.com/embed/');
                        }
                        videoIframe.src = videoUrl + "?autoplay=1";
                        videoModal.classList.remove('hidden');
                        videoModal.classList.add('flex');
                        setTimeout(() => videoModal.classList.remove('opacity-0'), 10);
                        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                    }
                });
            });

            const closeLightbox = () => {
                videoModal.classList.add('opacity-0');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    videoModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    videoModal.classList.remove('flex');
                    videoIframe.src = ''; 
                    document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
                }, 300);
            }

            closeVideoBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);
            videoModal?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if(e.target === videoModal) closeLightbox();
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>

import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout.astro';
import { sanityClient } from "sanity:client";
import { createImageUrlBuilder } from "@sanity/image-url";
import { PortableText } from "astro-portabletext";
import PortableTextImage from '../components/PortableTextImage.astro'; // <--- IMPORT KOMPONEN GAMBAR

export async function getStaticPaths() {
    const pages = await sanityClient.fetch(`*[_type == "page"]{ "params": { "slug": slug.current } }`);
    return pages;
}

const { slug } = Astro.params;
const page = await sanityClient.fetch(`*[_type == "page" && slug.current == $slug][0]{
    title, heroImage, body
}`, { slug });

const builder = createImageUrlBuilder(sanityClient);

function urlFor(source: any) {
    return builder.image(source).auto('format');
}

function estimateReadTime(body: any[]): number {
    if (!body) return 1;
    const text = body
        .filter((b: any) => b._type === 'block')
        .flatMap((b: any) => b.children || [])
        .map((c: any) => c.text || '')
        .join(' ');
    const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
    return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(words / 200));
}

const readTime = estimateReadTime(page?.body || []);

<script is:inline>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

    /* ── Reading progress ── */
    const progressBar    = document.getElementById('readingProgress');
    const sidebarProg    = document.getElementById('sidebarProgress');
    const sidebarProgPct = document.getElementById('sidebarProgressPct');
    const articleBody    = document.getElementById('articleBody');

    const updateProgress = () => {
        if (!articleBody || !progressBar) return;
        const rect     = articleBody.getBoundingClientRect();
        const total    = articleBody.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
        const scrolled = Math.max(0, -rect.top);
        const pct      = total > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((scrolled / total) * 100)) : 0;
        progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        if (sidebarProg)    sidebarProg.style.width = pct + '%';
        if (sidebarProgPct) sidebarProgPct.textContent = pct + '%';
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', updateProgress, { passive: true });
    updateProgress();

    /* ── Scroll-to-top: reveal after 300px ── */
    const scrollTopBtn = document.getElementById('scrollTop');
    if (scrollTopBtn) {
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const show = window.scrollY > 300;
            scrollTopBtn.style.opacity   = show ? '1' : '0';
            scrollTopBtn.style.transform = show ? 'translateY(0)' : 'translateY(8px)';
        }, { passive: true });
        scrollTopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        });
    }

    /* ── Share buttons ── */
    const url   = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);
    const title = encodeURIComponent(document.title);

    const setHref = (id, href) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.href = href;
    };
    setHref('shareWa',       `https://wa.me/?text=${title}%20${url}`);
    setHref('shareFb',       `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${url}`);
    setHref('shareX',        `https://x.com/intent/tweet?text=${title}&url=${url}`);
    setHref('shareWaMobile', `https://wa.me/?text=${title}%20${url}`);
    setHref('shareFbMobile', `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${url}`);
    setHref('shareXMobile',  `https://x.com/intent/tweet?text=${title}&url=${url}`);

    /* ── Copy link + toast ── */
    const toast = document.getElementById('copyToast');
    const showToast = () => {
        if (!toast) return;
        toast.style.opacity   = '1';
        toast.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%) translateY(0)';
        setTimeout(() => {
            toast.style.opacity   = '0';
            toast.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%) translateY(12px)';
        }, 2600);
    };
    const doCopy = () => {
        if (navigator.clipboard) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href).then(showToast);
        } else {
            const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
            ta.value = window.location.href;
            Object.assign(ta.style, { position: 'fixed', opacity: '0' });
            document.body.appendChild(ta);
            ta.select();
            document.execCommand('copy');
            document.body.removeChild(ta);
            showToast();
        }
    };
    document.getElementById('copyLink')?.addEventListener('click', doCopy);
    document.getElementById('copyLinkMobile')?.addEventListener('click', doCopy);

});
</script>

import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout.astro';
import { sanityClient } from "sanity:client";
import { createImageUrlBuilder } from "@sanity/image-url";

const data: any = await sanityClient.fetch(`{
  "home": *[_type == "homePage" && _id == "homePage"][0],
  "settings": *[_type == "siteSettings" && _id == "siteSettings"][0],
  "posts": *[_type == "post"] | order(publishedAt desc)[0..2] {
    title, slug, publishedAt, category, mainImage
  }
}`);

const { home, settings, posts } = data;
const builder = createImageUrlBuilder(sanityClient);

function urlFor(source: any) {
  return builder.image(source).auto('format');
}

function formatDate(dateString: string) {
    if (!dateString) return '';
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const day = date.getDate();
    const month = date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { month: 'short' }).toUpperCase().replace('.', '');
    return `${day} ${month}`;
}

let safeAchievements: any[] = home?.achievements || [];
if (safeAchievements.length > 0) {
    while (safeAchievements.length < 8) {
        safeAchievements = [...safeAchievements, ...home.achievements];
    }
}

let safeLogos: any[] = home?.alumniLogos || [];
if (safeLogos.length > 0) {
    while (safeLogos.length < 12) {
        safeLogos = [...safeLogos, ...home.alumniLogos];
    }
}

<style>
/* ─── Marquee ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

    50%       { opacity: 0.6; }

<script is:inline>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
       LOADING SCREEN
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    const loader    = document.getElementById('pageLoader');
    const loaderBar = document.getElementById('loaderBar');
    const loaderPct = document.getElementById('loaderPct');

    if (loader && loaderBar) {
        let progress = 0;
        const duration = 1800; // ms total
        const steps    = 60;
        const interval = duration / steps;

        const ease = t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

        const tick = setInterval(() => {
            progress++;
            const pct = Math.round(ease(progress / steps) * 100);
            loaderBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            if (loaderPct) loaderPct.textContent = pct + '%';

            if (progress >= steps) {
                clearInterval(tick);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    loader.classList.add('loader-exit');
                    loader.addEventListener('animationend', () => {
                        loader.style.display = 'none';
                        document.body.style.overflow = '';
                    }, { once: true });
                }, 250);
            }
        }, interval);

        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
       HERO IMAGE zoom-out
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    const heroImg = document.querySelector('.hero-img');
    if (heroImg) {
        setTimeout(() => { heroImg.style.transform = 'scale(1)'; }, 100);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
       CLOSE PPDB PANEL
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    const closePpdbBtn = document.getElementById('closePpdbBtn');
    const ppdbFloatBox = document.getElementById('ppdbFloatBox');
    if (closePpdbBtn && ppdbFloatBox) {
        closePpdbBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            ppdbFloatBox.classList.add('opacity-0', 'scale-90', 'pointer-events-none');
        });
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
       SCROLL REVEAL
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const revealObs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
                    revealObs.unobserve(entry.target); 
                }
            });
        }, {
            threshold: 0.12,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px'
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObs.observe(el));
    } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => el.classList.add('in-view'));
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
       TESTIMONI SLIDER
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    const slides  = document.querySelectorAll('.testi-slide');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevTesti');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextTesti');
    const dots    = document.querySelectorAll('.testi-dot');
    const counter = document.getElementById('testiCounter');
    const total   = slides.length;

    if (total > 1) {
        let cur = 0, iv;

        const updateCounter = () => {
            if (counter) counter.textContent = `${String(cur+1).padStart(2,'0')} / ${String(total).padStart(2,'0')}`;
        };

        const go = (idx) => {
            if (idx >= total) idx = 0;
            if (idx < 0)      idx = total - 1;
            cur = idx;

            slides.forEach((s, i) => {
                const on = i === cur;
                s.classList.toggle('opacity-100', on);
                s.classList.toggle('visible',     on);
                s.classList.toggle('relative',    on);
                s.classList.toggle('opacity-0',  !on);
                s.classList.toggle('invisible',  !on);
                s.classList.toggle('absolute',   !on);
            });

            dots.forEach((d, i) => {
                const on = i === cur;
                d.classList.toggle('w-7',           on);
                d.classList.toggle('h-[3px]',       on);
                d.classList.toggle('bg-yellow-500', on);
                d.classList.toggle('w-[3px]',      !on);
                d.classList.toggle('bg-white/20',  !on);
            });

            updateCounter();
        };

        const reset = () => { clearInterval(iv); iv = setInterval(() => go(cur + 1), 6000); };

        prevBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => { go(cur - 1); reset(); });
        nextBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => { go(cur + 1); reset(); });
        dots.forEach((d, i) => d.addEventListener('click', () => { go(i); reset(); }));
        reset();
    }

});
</script>



===== FILE: web/src/pages/news/[slug].astro =====

import MainLayout from '../../layouts/MainLayout.astro';
import { sanityClient } from "sanity:client";
import { createImageUrlBuilder } from "@sanity/image-url";
import { PortableText } from "astro-portabletext";
import PortableTextImage from '../../components/PortableTextImage.astro';

// 1. STATIC PATHS
export async function getStaticPaths() {
    const posts = await sanityClient.fetch(`*[_type == "post"]{ "params": { "slug": slug.current } }`);
    return posts;
}

// 2. FETCH ARTIKEL + 3 ARTIKEL TERKAIT
const { slug } = Astro.params;
const data = await sanityClient.fetch(`{
    "post": *[_type == "post" && slug.current == $slug][0]{
        title, publishedAt, category, tags, mainImage, body
    },
    "related": *[_type == "post" && slug.current != $slug] | order(publishedAt desc)[0..2] {
        title, slug, publishedAt, category, mainImage
    }
}`, { slug });

const { post, related } = data;
const builder = createImageUrlBuilder(sanityClient);

function urlFor(source: any) {
    return builder.image(source).auto('format');
}

function formatDate(dateString: string) {
    if (!dateString) return '';
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
}

function formatDateShort(dateString: string) {
    if (!dateString) return { day: '', month: '', year: '' };
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const day = date.getDate();
    const month = date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { month: 'short' }).toUpperCase().replace('.','');
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    return { day, month, year };
}

// Estimasi waktu baca
function estimateReadTime(body: any[]): number {
    if (!body) return 1;
    const text = body
        .filter((b: any) => b._type === 'block')
        .flatMap((b: any) => b.children || [])
        .map((c: any) => c.text || '')
        .join(' ');
    const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
    return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(words / 200));
}

const readTime = estimateReadTime(post?.body || []);
const dateFormatted = formatDate(post?.publishedAt);
const dateShort = formatDateShort(post?.publishedAt);

const categoryColors: Record<string, string> = {
    'Prestasi':          'bg-yellow-600',
    'Kegiatan Sekolah':  'bg-blue-700',
    'Akademik':          'bg-emerald-700',
    'Tahfidz':           'bg-purple-700',
    'Artikel':           'bg-gray-600',
    'Info PPS':          'bg-[#1E4E7D]',
};
const catColor = categoryColors[post?.category] || 'bg-[#2E6DA4]';

<script is:inline>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

    const progressBar     = document.getElementById('readingProgress');
    const sidebarProg     = document.getElementById('sidebarProgress');
    const sidebarProgPct  = document.getElementById('sidebarProgressPct');
    const articleBody     = document.getElementById('articleBody');

    const updateProgress = () => {
        if (!articleBody || !progressBar) return;
        const rect   = articleBody.getBoundingClientRect();
        const total  = articleBody.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
        const scrolled = Math.max(0, -rect.top);
        const pct    = total > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((scrolled / total) * 100)) : 0;
        
        progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        if (sidebarProg)    sidebarProg.style.width = pct + '%';
        if (sidebarProgPct) sidebarProgPct.textContent = pct + '%';
    };

    window.addEventListener('scroll', updateProgress, { passive: true });
    updateProgress();

    document.getElementById('scrollTop')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });

    const url   = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);
    const title = encodeURIComponent(document.title);

    const setShare = (id, href) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.href = href;
    };

    setShare('shareWa',       `https://wa.me/?text=${title}%20${url}`);
    setShare('shareFb',       `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${url}`);
    setShare('shareX',        `https://x.com/intent/tweet?text=${title}&url=${url}`);
    setShare('shareWaMobile', `https://wa.me/?text=${title}%20${url}`);
    setShare('shareFbMobile', `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${url}`);
    setShare('shareXMobile',  `https://x.com/intent/tweet?text=${title}&url=${url}`);

    const showToast = () => {
        const t = document.getElementById('copyToast');
        if (!t) return;
        t.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
        t.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
        setTimeout(() => {
            t.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
            t.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
        }, 2500);
    };

    const copyAction = () => {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href).then(showToast);
    };

    document.getElementById('copyLink')?.addEventListener('click', copyAction);
    document.getElementById('copyLinkMobile')?.addEventListener('click', copyAction);

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(e => {
                if (e.isIntersecting) {
                    e.target.classList.add('visible');
                    obs.unobserve(e.target);
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.15 });
        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal-related').forEach(el => obs.observe(el));
    } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal-related').forEach(el => el.classList.add('visible'));
    }
});
</script>

import MainLayout from '../../layouts/MainLayout.astro';
import { sanityClient } from "sanity:client";
import { createImageUrlBuilder } from "@sanity/image-url";

// Mengambil SEMUA post, diurutkan dari yang terbaru
const data: any = await sanityClient.fetch(`{
  "settings": *[_type == "siteSettings" && _id == "siteSettings"][0],
  "posts": *[_type == "post"] | order(publishedAt desc) {
    title, slug, publishedAt, category, mainImage, tags
  }
}`);

const { settings, posts } = data;
const builder = createImageUrlBuilder(sanityClient);

function urlFor(source: any) {
  return builder.image(source).auto('format');
}

// Fungsi format tanggal untuk kotak kalender
function formatDateShort(dateString: string) {
    if (!dateString) return { day: '', month: '', year: '' };
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const day = date.getDate();
    const month = date.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { month: 'short' }).toUpperCase().replace('.','');
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    return { day, month, year };
}

// Pisahkan post pertama (Featured) dan sisanya
const featuredPost = posts.length > 0 ? posts[0] : null;
const regularPosts = posts.length > 1 ? posts.slice(1) : [];

// Warna per kategori
const categoryColors: Record<string, string> = {
    'Prestasi':          'bg-yellow-600',
    'Kegiatan Sekolah':  'bg-blue-700',
    'Akademik':          'bg-emerald-700',
    'Tahfidz':           'bg-purple-700',
    'Artikel':           'bg-gray-600',
    'Info PPS':          'bg-[#1E4E7D]',
};

/* ─── Scroll Reveal Animations ────────────────────────────── */
.reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    will-change: opacity, transform;
    transition:
        opacity 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
        transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    transition-delay: var(--reveal-delay, 0ms);
}

.reveal-up    { transform: translateY(36px); }
.reveal-left  { transform: translateX(-28px); }

.reveal.in-view {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
}

<script is:inline>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       SCROLL REVEAL (IntersectionObserver)
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const revealObs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
                    revealObs.unobserve(entry.target); 
                }
            });
        }, {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObs.observe(el));
    } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => el.classList.add('in-view'));
    }
});
</script>

import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout.astro';
import { sanityClient } from "sanity:client";
import { createImageUrlBuilder } from "@sanity/image-url";

const data: any = await sanityClient.fetch(`{
  "pageData": *[_type == "pageTeam" && _id == "pageTeam"][0],
  "teamMembers": *[_type == "team"] | order(order asc) {
    name, role, photo, educationDegree, university, email, linkedin
  }
}`);

const { pageData, teamMembers } = data;
const builder = createImageUrlBuilder(sanityClient);

function urlFor(source: any) {
  return builder.image(source).auto('format');
}

// Kumpulkan semua role unik untuk filter bar
const allRoles: string[] = [];
(teamMembers || []).forEach((m: any) => {
  if (m.role && !allRoles.includes(m.role)) allRoles.push(m.role);
});

const totalCount = teamMembers?.length || 0;

        <div class="flex items-center overflow-x-auto" style="scrollbar-width: none; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;">
            <button 
                class="filter-btn active flex-shrink-0 px-5 py-4 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.25em] border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap"
                data-filter="all">
                Semua
            </button>
            {allRoles.map((role: string) => (
                <button 
                    class="filter-btn flex-shrink-0 px-5 py-4 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.25em] border-b-2 border-transparent text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors duration-200 whitespace-nowrap"
                    data-filter={role}>
                    {role}
                </button>
            ))}
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
)}


<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
     TEAM GRID
═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<main class="bg-[#fafaf9] py-16 md:py-24 min-h-[50vh]">
    <div class="container mx-auto px-6 md:px-12">

        {teamMembers && teamMembers.length > 0 ? (
        <div id="teamGrid" class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4 md:gap-6">
            {teamMembers.map((member: any, i: number) => (
                <div 
                    class="team-card group reveal reveal-up"
                    data-role={member.role || ''}
                    style={`--reveal-delay: ${(i % 5) * 65}ms`}>

                    <!-- Portrait -->
                    <div class="portrait-wrap relative overflow-hidden bg-gray-900 cursor-default"
                         style="aspect-ratio: 3/4;">

                        <!-- Photo -->
                        <img 
                            src={member.photo 
                                ? urlFor(member.photo).width(480).height(640).url()
                                : `https://placehold.co/480x640/111827/374151?text=${encodeURIComponent(member.name?.charAt(0) || '?')}`}
                            alt={member.name}
                            loading="lazy"
                            class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-[900ms] ease-out group-hover:scale-[1.08]">

                        <!-- Always-on gradient for name readability -->
                        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 via-black/10 to-transparent pointer-events-none"></div>

                        <!-- Hover info overlay -->
                        <div class="info-overlay absolute inset-0 flex flex-col justify-end p-4 pointer-events-none"
                             style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0%, rgba(100,0,0,0.0) 40%, rgba(100,0,0,0.88) 100%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.45s ease;">

                            <div class="edu-block" style="transform: translateY(10px); transition: transform 0.4s ease;">
                                {(member.educationDegree || member.university) && (
                                    <div class="mb-3">
                                        {member.educationDegree && (
                                            <span class="inline-block text-yellow-400 text-[8px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.3em] mb-1 block">
                                                {member.educationDegree}
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                        {member.university && (
                                            <p class="text-white text-xs font-medium leading-snug opacity-90">
                                                {member.university}
                                            </p>
                                        )}
                                    </div>
                                )}
                                {(member.email || member.linkedin) && (
                                    <div class="flex gap-1.5 pointer-events-auto">
                                        {member.email && (
                                            <a href={`mailto:${member.email}`}
                                               class="w-8 h-8 border border-white/25 flex items-center justify-center text-white/80 hover:bg-yellow-500 hover:border-yellow-500 hover:text-[#2E6DA4] transition-all duration-200 rounded-sm"
                                               title="Email" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
                                                <i class="fa-solid fa-envelope text-[10px]"></i>
                                            </a>
                                        )}
                                        {member.linkedin && (
                                            <a href={member.linkedin} target="_blank" rel="noopener"
                                               class="w-8 h-8 border border-white/25 flex items-center justify-center text-white/80 hover:bg-yellow-500 hover:border-yellow-500 hover:text-[#2E6DA4] transition-all duration-200 rounded-sm"
                                               title="LinkedIn" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
                                                <i class="fa-brands fa-linkedin-in text-[10px]"></i>
                                            </a>
                                        )}
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Degree badge: always visible, top-right -->
                        {member.educationDegree && (
                            <div class="absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 z-10">
                                <span class="bg-black/55 backdrop-blur-sm text-yellow-400 text-[8px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.15em] px-2 py-1 block">
                                    {member.educationDegree.split(' ')[0]}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        <!-- Corner accent: TL -->
                        <div class="absolute top-0 left-0 w-7 h-px bg-yellow-500 origin-left scale-x-0 group-hover:scale-x-100 transition-transform duration-500 delay-75 z-20"></div>
                        <div class="absolute top-0 left-0 h-7 w-px bg-yellow-500 origin-top scale-y-0 group-hover:scale-y-100 transition-transform duration-500 delay-75 z-20"></div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Below-photo info -->
                    <div class="pt-3 pb-1">
                        <h3 class="text-gray-900 font-bold text-sm leading-tight line-clamp-2 mb-0.5 group-hover:text-[#2E6DA4] transition-colors duration-200">
                            {member.name}
                        </h3>
                        <p class="text-[#2E6DA4]/60 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider line-clamp-1">
                            {member.role || '—'}
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Bottom accent bar -->
                    <div class="h-px bg-yellow-500 w-0 group-hover:w-full transition-all duration-500 mt-1"></div>
                </div>
            ))}
        </div>

        ) : (
        <div class="py-32 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            <div class="w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-users text-3xl text-gray-300"></i>
            </div>
            <p class="text-gray-400 text-sm font-light mb-2">Data guru dan staf belum ditambahkan.</p>
            <p class="text-gray-300 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest">Silakan tambahkan melalui CMS</p>
        </div>
        )}

        <!-- Empty filter result -->
        <div id="noResults" class="hidden py-24 text-center">
            <p class="text-gray-400 text-sm">Tidak ada anggota untuk kategori ini.</p>
        </div>

    </div>
</main>


<!-- Footer strip -->
<div class="bg-[#05070c] py-10" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);">
    <div class="container mx-auto px-6 md:px-16 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <p class="text-white/20 text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.45em] font-bold">SMA ABBS Yogyakarta — Tenaga Pendidik</p>
        <a href="/" 
           class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 border text-white/40 hover:text-yellow-400 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold px-5 py-2.5 transition-all duration-200 group"
           style="border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left text-[9px] group-hover:-translate-x-0.5 transition-transform duration-200"></i>
            Beranda
        </a>
    </div>
</div>

</MainLayout>

/* ═══ Hero animations ══════════════════════════════════ */

    to   { transform: scale(1);    filter: blur(0);   opacity: 1; }
}
.hero-cover-img { animation: heroCoverIn 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) forwards; }

@keyframes heroUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
.hero-meta  { animation: heroUp 0.7s ease forwards 0.5s;  opacity: 0; }
.hero-title { animation: heroUp 0.8s ease forwards 0.65s; opacity: 0; }
.hero-desc  { animation: heroUp 0.7s ease forwards 0.85s; opacity: 0; }
.hero-stat  { animation: heroUp 0.7s ease forwards 1.0s;  opacity: 0; }

/* ═══ Filter bar ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
.filter-btn {
    color: #9CA3AF;
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}
.filter-btn.active {
    color: #2E6DA4;
    border-bottom-color: #2E6DA4;
}
.filter-btn:hover:not(.active) {
    color: #374151;
    border-bottom-color: #E5E7EB;
}

/* ═══ Scroll Reveal ════════════════════════════════════ */
.reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    will-change: opacity, transform;
    transition:
        opacity  0.7s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
        transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    transition-delay: var(--reveal-delay, 0ms);
}
.reveal-up   { transform: translateY(28px); }
.reveal-left { transform: translateX(-24px); }
.reveal.in-view { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

/* ═══ Card hover: CSS-driven overlay ══════════════════ */
.team-card:hover .info-overlay { opacity: 1 !important; }
.team-card:hover .edu-block    { transform: translateY(0) !important; }

/* ═══ Filter: hidden cards ═════════════════════════════ */
.team-card.filtered-out { display: none; }

</style>


<script is:inline>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

    /* ── Scroll Reveal ────────────────────────────────── */
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(e => {
                if (e.isIntersecting) {
                    e.target.classList.add('in-view');
                    obs.unobserve(e.target);
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => obs.observe(el));
    } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => el.classList.add('in-view'));
    }

    /* ── Filter ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');
    const cards      = document.querySelectorAll('.team-card');
    const noResults  = document.getElementById('noResults');

    filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            btn.classList.add('active');

            const filter = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
            let visible  = 0;

            cards.forEach(card => {
                const role = card.getAttribute('data-role') || '';
                const show = filter === 'all' || role === filter;
                card.classList.toggle('filtered-out', !show);
                if (show) visible++;
            });

            if (noResults) noResults.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
        });
    });

});
</script>

@import "tailwindcss";

/*
 * PALET WARNA SMA ABBS YOGYAKARTA
 * ================================
 * Biru muda adalah warna DOMINAN (ciri khas unit ini) — dipakai di semua
 * tempat yang tadinya maroon (tombol CTA, panel menu, background besar).
 * Maroon DIHAPUS dari seluruh UI (dianggap terlalu berat/gelap untuk
 * desain yang ringan & premium). Peran aksen ketiga sekarang GOLD/
 * CHAMPAGNE — kombinasi biru+emas klasik ala sekolah internasional
 * (Cambridge/Oxford), cocok dengan positioning ICP.
 *
 * "#800000" literal di file .astro sudah diganti biru (#2E6DA4) di semua
 * tempat KECUALI beberapa garis gradient dua-warna dan badge kategori
 * "Info PPS" yang sengaja dipertahankan maroon sebagai aksen.
 *
 * Skala "yellow" Tailwind di-override ke GOLD di sini — supaya semua
 * pemakaian text-yellow-400, bg-yellow-500, dst di seluruh file
 * otomatis jadi gold (peran aksen), tanpa perlu ganti class satu-satu.
 */
@theme {
  --color-yellow-300: #E8C468;
  --color-yellow-400: #D9B54A;
  --color-yellow-500: #C9A227;
  --color-yellow-600: #A8841D;
}
